company: Akamai Technologies, Inc. (Linode, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary)

ownership.parent: Akamai Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: AKAM, a public company)
ownership.quote: Linode was acquired by Akamai Technologies in February 2022 for $900 million.

stage.quote: On February 15, 2022, Akamai Technologies announced its intent to acquire Linode for $900 million.
stage.note: Linode was a bootstrapped, founder-owned private company (founded 2003 by Christopher Aker, self-funded, no VC rounds found) until it was fully acquired by publicly-traded Akamai Technologies in Feb 2022 (deal closed March 2022). It now operates as Akamai's cloud computing business line ('Linode' / 'Akamai Cloud'), not an independently funded startup.

last_round.quote: On February 15, 2022, Akamai Technologies announced its intent to acquire Linode for $900 million.

revenue.as_of: FY2025 (whole-company Akamai Technologies, not broken out for Linode)
revenue.basis: Akamai Technologies FY2025 10-K, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax, filed 2026-02-20 with the SEC. Linode's own pre-acquisition revenue was reported by Wikipedia's infobox as '$100 million' (unsourced/undated) but that figure predates the 2022 acquisition and is not independently verifiable; Akamai does not break out Linode/cloud-computing segment revenue separately.

employees.value: 200+ (Linode standalone, pre-acquisition, per Wikipedia infobox; Akamai overall has ~10,000+ employees)

note: Linode is not an independent, separately funded company: it was a bootstrapped private company acquired outright by publicly-traded Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ: AKAM) for $900M cash in Feb 2022, and now operates as Akamai's cloud-computing/VM product line ('Akamai Cloud' / Linode). Revenue figure above is Akamai's whole-company FY2025 revenue (public 10-K), since Akamai does not disclose Linode's standalone revenue post-acquisition.
